explication: ChatGPT UI is a multi-user, multilingual web client; its server is a separate project. The main user journey is sign-in, open or create a conversation, interact with messages, and manage conversation history. Other documented or visible capabilities include model tuning, API-key configuration, document management, localization, and account registration. The excerpts show page-level conversation loading and navigation actions, but not the message-send implementation or most component internals; uncertain links are therefore omitted or marked dashed.
